acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Henry Dee has been locked up for most of his life, nearly 50 years. Now, he’s up for parole. Reporter Ben Austen tells the story.

acts.label: Part 1
acts.desc: The parole board members puzzle through the pros and cons of releasing Henry Dee from prison and cast their votes.

acts.label: Part 2
acts.desc: Reporter Ben Austen continues the story.
